items: Kept the Settings dropdown above dashboard cards in themes that use blurred surfaces.
Added multi-server selection across the dashboard and companion apps, with combined usage and server-grouped quota views.
Added browser-side server health checks, offline-friendly server setup, and automatic recovery after a server becomes reachable.
Companion settings now migrate the previous single-server preference into the multi-server format without resetting other preferences.
Sessions requests now use two-tool concurrency so one cold scan does not block the remaining tools.
Improved startup warming, stale-response refreshes, persistent session indexing, and cache compatibility across wheel restamps.
Made the active homepage date range immediately visible with a localized, keyboard-accessible range selector.
Companion apps now show multi-day quota resets in days, matching the dashboard.
